info.name: Reonic REST Api v3 Activities Commercial Projects API

params.name: stage
params.description: Filter by lifecycle stages: request, offer, installation. Omit to include all stages.

params.name: dealState
params.description: Filter by deal state. Omit to include all.

params.name: archived
params.description: Controls whether archived projects appear in results. Default: exclude.

params.name: search
params.description: Free-text search across project name, customer name, and address fields.

params.name: tagIds
params.description: Filter projects that are tagged with any of the specified tag IDs. Pass `null` to return only projects that have no tags.

params.name: userIds
params.description: Filter projects that have a user with any of the specified IDs assigned. Pass `null` to return only projects with no assigned user.

params.name: teamIds
params.description: Filter projects that have a team with any of the specified IDs assigned. Pass `null` to return only projects with no assigned team.

params.name: kanbanBoardIds
params.description: Filter projects that are in any of the specified Kanban boards. Pass `null` to return only projects that are not assigned to any Kanban board.

params.name: kanbanColumnIds
params.description: Filter projects that are in any of the specified Kanban columns. Pass `null` to return only projects that have no status assigned (the "no status" column).

params.name: requestCreatedAt.gt
params.description: Filter records where requestCreatedAt is after this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: requestCreatedAt.lt
params.description: Filter records where requestCreatedAt is before this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: offerCreatedAt.gt
params.description: Filter records where offerCreatedAt is after this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: offerCreatedAt.lt
params.description: Filter records where offerCreatedAt is before this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: installationCreatedAt.gt
params.description: Filter records where installationCreatedAt is after this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: installationCreatedAt.lt
params.description: Filter records where installationCreatedAt is before this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: lastEditedAt.gt
params.description: Filter records where lastEditedAt is after this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: lastEditedAt.lt
params.description: Filter records where lastEditedAt is before this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting from 1. Default: 1.

params.name: itemsPerPage
params.description: Number of items per page. Default: 50. Max: 200.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Use field names for ascending (e.g. "createdAt"), minus sign for descending (e.g. "-createdAt"). Chain with commas (e.g. "createdAt,editedAt"). Sortable fields: projectCreatedAt, requestCreatedAt, offerCreatedAt, installationCreatedAt, lastEditedAt. Defaults to -projectCreatedAt.

items.docs:
List commercial projects across all lifecycle stages (request, offer, installation) in a paginated format. Use the `stage` query param to restrict to one or more stages; omit to span all three.

**Examples:**
- Most recent offers: `GET /commercialProjects?stage=offer&sort=-offerCreatedAt&page=1`
- Open offers: `GET /commercialProjects?stage=offer&dealState=open`
- Projects assigned to specific Kanban columns: `GET /commercialProjects?kanbanColumnIds=<uuid>&kanbanColumnIds=<uuid>`

**Allowed API

Get a single commercial project by its ID. Works for any stage (request, offer, or installation).

**Allowed API keys:** Read-only, Read and Write
